summary: Ephemeral obfuscated prod slice for cross-team billing reconciliation
description: Issue summary: Finance Ops has identified a discrepancy in per-customer token billing for a 48-hour window and requests a minimal, obfuscated slice of production request/response metadata to reconcile. Impact: potential underbilling for a small set (~120) of customer accounts; customer-facing invoices may be affected if we cannot reconcile. Justification: discrepancy appears correlated with a short-lived routing change on 2026-03-02 that may have caused duplicate multiplexing of requests at the proxy layer. Finance needs low-fidelity evidence (hashed identifiers + anonymized payload lengths/tokens) to reconcile internal billing ledgers and produce corrected invoices if required. Requestor: Liam Chen (Finance Ops). Priority: timeboxed — provide slice within 5 business days. Approval path: Privacy review -> SRE extraction -> Two-person control handoff to Finance.
request_details: Data requested: - 2026-03-02T00:00:00Z to 2026-03-03T23:59:59Z - Include only metadata: request_id, customer_hash (HMAC-SHA256 with team key), model_name, route, timestamp, total_tokens, billed_tokens, response_status, proxy_route_id. - Exclude any raw prompt or model outputs. - Limit to accounts flagged by finance (list provided separately). - Max rows: 2000. Delivery: secure ephemeral CSV S3 link with KMS encryption, access only to two Finance Ops principals for 72 hours.
safeguards_plan: Redaction and controls: 1) All PII and prompt/output fields will be omitted at extraction time by the telemetry export job. 2) Customer identifiers will be HMAC-hashed using rotating team key; original identifiers will not be exported. 3) Export will run on a dedicated read-only task instance in prod VPC with ephemeral IAM role. 4) Two-person control: SRE (Priya Nair) and Privacy (Marco Ruiz) must approve and sign off prior to transfer. 5) Audit: full audit log will be captured (who accessed link, when, download events) and stored in COS for 12 months. 6) Retention: exported slice auto-deletes after 72 hours; S3 lifecycle enforces deletion and versioning quarantine. 7) No external sharing permitted; Finance must confirm deletion after reconciliation.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-09: Initial triage by Support (Ava) — discrepancy appears limited to a subset of routes; finance provided preliminary account hashes.
2026-03-10: SRE ran a non-exporting dry query to validate selectors; confirmed that required fields are available in telemetry indices without needing payload joins.
2026-03-11: Privacy reviewed the planned HMAC approach; requested key escrow documentation and a signed DPA acknowledgement from Finance Ops.
2026-03-12: SRE prepared extraction job template and a runbook; pending final sign-off from Security for ephemeral role.
Hypothesis: duplicated billing tokens introduced during router v2 rollout between proxy-A/B leading to double-counting in billed_tokens metric; need slice to confirm per-request token attribution.
resolution: Pending: awaiting Security approval of ephemeral IAM role and Privacy sign-off on HMAC key rotation documentation. Target to provision encrypted slice by 2026-03-13 if approvals complete.
comments: Liam Chen (Finance Ops) 2026-03-09: Provided list of 128 customer account IDs (sensitive) via secure form; requests obfuscated output only.
Priya Nair (SRE) 2026-03-10: Ran validation query; fields exist in telemetry._requests index. Will use a read-only batch extractor with strict field whitelist.

Marco Ruiz (Privacy) 2026-03-11: HMAC approach acceptable. Please provide key rotation plan and confirm no raw prompts will be present. Also request signed acknowledgement from Finance that data will be deleted after use.
Ravi Patel (Assignee) 2026-03-12: Security is reviewing ephemeral IAM role policy. I will coordinate handoff and publish the runbook in the linked Confluence page once extraction starts.
Security Bot 2026-03-12: Automated check found a missing kms:Decrypt condition on the export role; Security to approve once condition added.
